from datetime import datetime

# Fetch all spotify recommendations (paginated)
recs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=spotify_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    # print page length
    print('recs page',page_index,'len',len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    recs.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

print('total_recommendations',len(recs))
print('sample_song_ids', [r.get('song_id') for r in recs[:10]])

# Fetch song details for all recommendations
song_details=[]
for r in recs:
    sid=r['song_id']
    details=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    details['rec_song_id']=sid
    song_details.append(details)

print('fetched_song_details',len(song_details))
print('sample',song_details[0].get('title'), song_details[0].get('genre'), song_details[0].get('release_date'))

# Filter for R&B and release year in current/last
years={current_year,last_year}
filtered=[d for d in song_details if d.get('genre')=='R&B' and (d.get('release_date','')[:4].isdigit() and int(d['release_date'][:4]) in years)]
print('rnb_released_this_or_last_year',len(filtered))
print('filtered_song_ids', [d['song_id'] for d in filtered])
print('filtered_titles', [ (d['title'], d['release_date'][:4]) for d in filtered])

# Use existing variables from prior execution: song_details, current_year, last_year
# Reconstruct filtered safely from song_details in case of state reset
from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now(); current_year=now.year; last_year=current_year-1

years={current_year,last_year}
filtered=[]
for d in song_details:
    rd=d.get('release_date','')
    y=rd[:4] if isinstance(rd,str) else ''
    if d.get('genre')=='R&B' and y.isdigit() and int(y) in years:
        filtered.append(d)

# unique song ids
uniq_ids=sorted({d['song_id'] for d in filtered})
print('current_year',current_year,'last_year',last_year)
print('filtered_count',len(filtered),'unique_song_ids',len(uniq_ids))

# Build a display table
for d in sorted(filtered, key=lambda x: x['song_id']):
    artists=', '.join([a.get('name') for a in d.get('artists',[])])
    print('song_id',d['song_id'],'title',d.get('title'),'artists',artists,'release_year',d.get('release_date','')[:4],'genre',d.get('genre'))
